query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So Long, Stephen — The Legend Leaves the Building!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix bugs — they *become* the bug whisperer. 🐛✨ And Stephen, you were the greatest whisperer we ever had!

From keeping our systems running smoother than a perfectly optimized algorithm, to blessing our Slack channels with the finest memes the internet has ever produced 🐸💻 — you made every day at work a little brighter, a little funnier, and a whole lot better.

You didn't just write great code, you wrote great memories. And just like your memes, those memories will live on the internet of our hearts… forever. ❤️

As you close this tab and open a bold new one, remember: the world is your IDE, and your potential is *unlimited lines of code*. 🚀

Go out there and **ship greatness**, Stephen. We'll be watching your career like it's the best meme page we've ever followed. 👏

**We'll miss you more than a missing semicolon.** 😄

*All the best on your next adventure!*

— Your forever fans at [Company Name] 💙

---

Feel free to tweak the company name or add any personal inside jokes to make it even more special! 🎊
